200.answer: WireCare is a maintenance plan that protects you from telephone wiring repair costs. It costs $6.95 per month and covers inside wiring and jacks for normal use or accidental damage, as well as all Bell-related repair fees associated with a technician's visit. You must allow 15 days from the date you subscribe to the plan before making a claim. WireCare is available to residents of Ontario and Québec.
